output_list.reason: The 'mintToken' function has an integer overflow that allows the owner to set the balance of an arbitrary user to any value.
The 'transfer' function fails to check if the transfer value is zero, causing a token to be unusable.
The 'burnFrom' function has an integer overflow that allows a user to burn tokens belonging to others, if they know the target's balance.
The 'setPrices' function has an integer overflow that allows the owner to set arbitrary balances, causing a denial of service.
The 'buy' function has an integer overflow that allows any user to take arbitrary token balance from the contract owner, causing a denial of service.
